subject: [RFC PATCH 3/3] iommu/iova: add KUnit test suite

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a KUnit test suite for the iommu/iova allocator, which checks various invariants and edge cases such as allocation across different orders, reserved ranges, and DMA limits. The test suite also covers stress testing with random allocations and frees, as well as specific failure scenarios to ensure that the IOVA_DEFERRED marker is correctly handled. The patch includes a new KUnit configuration file and modifies several existing files to enable the test suite.
